policy.typed_once: Every public measured value used by the ledger is typed exactly once in this file and referenced by id.
policy.uncertainty_convention: uncertainty is the quoted 68 percent (one sigma) half-width; upper_bound rows carry confidence_level instead.
policy.transcription: provenance_note states how the digits were obtained; no item is flagged for re-verification before a freeze.
